svg.text: The keep was a wizard's retreat until the experiments went wrong. Now bandits use it as their hideout.
A sage will pay well for what is written on its walls.
Torch brackets line the walls, all empty.
A floor mosaic maps the halls.
A cold draught blows from somewhere. Dust Mephit and 4 ×
Torch brackets line the walls, all empty.
A broken table lies on its side.
Fresh footprints cross the dust. 10 × Awakened Shrub, lost
A faint humming comes from the stone. A skeleton lies just
The ceiling is lost in darkness. Faint runes glow
Bones are swept into one corner.
The air is warm and close.
The flagstones are cracked and uneven.
